lines.en: Gimbal and Fletch but if I told my dad, he'd say,
lines.zh: 我昨天差点抓到一只。

lines.en: It's all inside your head. You really cannot catch them or find their whereabouts.
lines.zh: 这都是你脑子里想的。你根本抓不到它们，也找不到它们的踪迹。

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但是如果你需要一张照片，请不要……

lines.en: The Washing Machine Look at that, Simka! They're showing Titanic on the television!
lines.zh: 洗衣机。看那台辛卡，电视上正在播放《泰坦尼克号》。

lines.en: Hey, Nolik! That's not a television! That's a machine for washing laundry!
lines.zh: 嘿，别开玩笑了，那不是电视，那是洗衣机。不会吧？

lines.en: No way! Yeah, it's just a plain old washing machine, Nolik, don't you know?
lines.zh: 是的，它只是一台普通的洗衣机。诺拉，你不知道吗？

lines.en: Uh -uh! Tell me about it! You're such a great explainer!
lines.zh: 呃……跟我说说吧，你真是个很棒的讲解员。

lines.en: Inside of a washing machine is a big drum.
lines.zh: 洗衣机里面有一个大滚筒

lines.en: People put their dirty laundry in there and
lines.zh: 人们把脏衣服放进去

lines.en: add a special kind of soap called detergent.
lines.zh: 然后加入一种叫做洗涤剂的特殊肥皂。

lines.en: When they turn the washing machine on,
lines.zh: 当他们打开洗衣机时……滚筒注满水

lines.en: the drum fills with water, and then the motor starts to spin the drum.
lines.zh: 然后电机开始旋转滚筒

lines.en: That makes the laundry rub together,
lines.zh: 使衣物相互摩擦

lines.en: forcing the soapy water in and the dirt out to make your clothes clean.
lines.zh: 将肥皂水带入，污垢排出，从而洗净衣物。

lines.en: After that, all that's left is to get out the water by spinning
lines.zh: 之后，只需高速旋转滚筒

lines.en: the drum really fast and sending the water down the drain.
lines.zh: 将水排入下水道即可。

lines.en: Oh, thanks a lot, Simka!
lines.zh: 哦，谢谢你，辛卡

lines.en: I always wondered, why would you want to put laundry inside a television?
lines.zh: 我一直想知道你为什么要把衣服放进电视机里

lines.en: Are you joking with me? Uh -huh! Oh, I'll show you a funny joke.
lines.zh: 你在开玩笑吗？嗯哼，哦，我给你讲个笑话

lines.en: Get over here! Shhh! It's Town Thomas' mother!
lines.zh: 过来。

lines.en: She's got headphones on, we're safe. She doesn't hear anything except the music.
lines.zh: 她除了音乐什么也没听到。

lines.en: Now she'll come back, add the soap,
lines.zh: 现在她会回来的，加点肥皂

lines.en: turn on her television, and watch the second part of the movie.
lines.zh: 打开电视，再看一遍电影的第二部分

lines.en: Again with the jokes! This time I'm really gonna let you have it!
lines.zh: 这次我要好好招待你。

lines.en: Whoa! Nolik, just do what I say. I came up with a plan.
lines.zh: 听我的，我想了个计划

lines.en: What's your plan? To run away!
lines.zh: 你的计划是什么？逃跑吗？

lines.en: Who's here? Hello?
lines.zh: 谁在这儿？你好。

lines.en: There are a lot of things to keep in
lines.zh: 搬家。

lines.en: mind with a washing machine to use it right. For example,
lines.zh: 使用洗衣机有很多需要注意的地方，例如

lines.en: do you know what can happen if you wash red and white shirts together?
lines.zh: 你知道什么如果你把红白衬衫一起洗

lines.en: Well, the white one might just turn pink!
lines.zh: 就会发生这种情况：白色的衬衫可能会变成粉红色。

lines.en: No! It's not because it's embarrassed, but because some of the color from the
lines.zh: 不，这不是因为它害羞，而是因为红色

lines.en: red shirt happened to get onto the white one.
lines.zh: 衬衫上的颜色沾到了白色的衬衫上

lines.en: Another important thing to remember is to
lines.zh: 还有一点很重要

lines.en: empty your pockets before you wash your clothes.
lines.zh: 洗衣服之前一定要把口袋里的东西都掏出来。

lines.en: Things like keys, nails, and chewing gum might not only ruin your clothes,
lines.zh: 像钥匙、指甲和口香糖之类的东西不仅会弄脏衣服

lines.en: but they can destroy the washer too!
lines.zh: 还会损坏洗衣机。

lines.en: And this isn't only about little stuff.
lines.zh: 而且这不仅仅是小事

lines.en: Big things like music players and mobile phones have
lines.zh: 像音乐播放器和手机这样的大件物品

lines.en: managed to find their way into the washing machine.
lines.zh: 也曾被塞进洗衣机

lines.en: Oh, sure! These things look nice and clean after a good washing,
lines.zh: 当然，这些东西洗完之后看起来干净整洁

lines.en: but they certainly don't seem to want to work anymore!
lines.zh: 但它们肯定已经不能用了。还有

lines.en: And never ever put a pet inside of a washing machine.
lines.zh: 千万不要把宠物放进洗衣机里

lines.en: That's just no place for a living thing!
lines.zh: 那里根本不适合活物。

lines.en: Na -na -na -na -na -na -na -na -na -ma
lines.zh: 啦啦啦……

lines.en: -ma -ma -ma -ma -ma -ma -ma -ma -ma -ma -ma!
lines.zh: 啦啦啦啦！

lines.en: You know what, Simka? I've never been laundered in my entire life!
lines.zh: 你知道吗，辛卡，我这辈子都没洗过衣服。

lines.en: We better get out of here, Nolik, right now!
lines.zh: 我们最好赶紧离开这里，诺利克，马上！

lines.en: And the faster the better!
lines.zh: 越快越好！

lines.en: Come on, let's get going!
lines.zh: 走吧

lines.en: And what about Chewsocka? What about Chewsocka?
lines.zh: 萨卡，你呢？萨卡

lines.en: Let her get washed up a little in there.
lines.zh: 让她在里面洗洗

lines.en: Maybe it will make her nicer. But she could drown, the poor thing.
lines.zh: 也许会让她更乖一些，但她可能会把可怜的小家伙淹死。

lines.en: I don't think we can do this alone.
lines.zh: 我觉得我们自己搞不定

lines.en: We should get help from Tom Thomas' mother.
lines.zh: 应该去找汤姆·托马斯的妈妈帮忙。

lines.en: One, two, stop! What? She moved out of the way!
lines.zh: 她让开了。

lines.en: And three! Pull it! Huh?
lines.zh: 咦？

lines.en: What is that? Oh my goodness!
lines.zh: 那是什么？我的天哪！

lines.en: Oh, my sweet little baby! How did you get in there?
lines.zh: 哦，我亲爱的小宝贝，你怎么进去的？

lines.en: You wait right here in the tub and I'll go get you a tub.
lines.zh: 你就在浴缸里等着

lines.en: Coward! So, you wild little beast! Looks like we saved your life!
lines.zh: 我去给你拿条毛巾。你这只小野兽，看来我们救了你的命

lines.en: We're friends now?
lines.zh: 我们现在是朋友了。

lines.en: No, like, it sure doesn't look like she wants to be our friend.
lines.zh: 不，看起来她并不想和我们做朋友。

lines.en: So what do we do now?
lines.zh: 那我们现在怎么办？

lines.en: Same old plan! Run!
lines.zh: 还是老一套。
